summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing an expected presidential transition. President Ricardo Roa Barragán returns from leave on July 27, serves through July 30, 2026, then departs. The Board appointed Juan Carlos Hurtado Parra as Acting President effective July 31 until a permanent successor is selected via the company's Succession Policy. No terms, price, or advisor details are provided as this is a leadership change. This is an abrupt CEO departure classified under Management Changes, not a routine HR update. Investors should monitor the selection process and any strategic shifts under new leadership.
